title: About TympaHealth | Ear & Hearing Health Innovation
lines: button, Toggle navigation, 1 control, not expanded
TympaHealth is a team of doctors, audiologists and technology experts united by a mission to help the world achieve better ear and hearing health.

Tympa is the only fully comprehensive ear and hearing health solution, designed to seamlessly integrate into pharmacies, care homes, and audiology clinics, whilst providing new service models for healthcare professionals.
Dr. Krishan Ramdoo is an international speaker, researcher, educator, and clinical entrepreneur committed to improving how communities access ear and hearing health.

After starting his medical career at Oxford University hospitals, he went on to become an Ear, Nose and Throat surgeon in London, and then registering his PhD at University College of London. From there he became keenly aware of the impact of hearing loss and the limitations of the current care system.
Coupled with his education and background, Dr. Krishan Ramdoo’s determination to change the landscape of ear and hearing health culminated in the birth of TympaHealth.
heading, How we’re globalising ear and hearing health, level 2

TympaHealth has a team of world-leading researchers from the fields of ENT, Audiology, Physics, and Machine Learning, dedicated to helping the world achieve better ear and hearing health. Beyond expanding our services within communities, we are continually making scientific advances through clinically validated and peer-reviewed research.

Beyond bringing TympaHealth into highly populated communities, we’ve brought on-the-ground care to remote locations where ear and hearing health is otherwise very difficult, if not impossible, to access.
